value.rationale: This naturally defined first angular harmonic is an experimentally interpretable fluctuating order parameter. Its exact variance is blind to the nematic transition but its fourth moment is an all-N nonnegative order witness, and the full law becomes non-Gaussian below criticality; the critical finite-size amplitude and Fourier correction quantify detectability. The result addresses a specific open observable in the source model, not a routine substitution or arbitrary slice.
